note: Insight text for the web test. themes: neutral names shown during the test (no poles, no judgement). poles: what a low/high score means, shown only on the results page. combos: shown only on the results page when both dimensions are clearly on the given side. Translations live under "insights" in data/i18n/<lang>.json (combo conditions stay here).

empathy.low: Other people's troubles don't pull you in much; you keep a cooler distance.
empathy.high: You pick up on how others feel and it moves you.

honesty.low: You're willing to bend the rules or work on people to get what you want.
honesty.high: You'd rather play it straight, even when a shortcut would pay off.

self_image.low: You tend to doubt yourself and play down what you can do.
self_image.high: You see yourself as unusually capable, a cut above most.

admiration_seeking.low: You don't need an audience; attention is something you can do without.
admiration_seeking.high: Being seen and admired matters to you, and you enjoy the spotlight.

dominance.low: You're happy to let others steer and make the calls.
dominance.high: You naturally take charge and like to set the direction.

sociability.low: You're quieter with people and recharge on your own.
sociability.high: You get energy from people and like being in the mix.

anxiety.low: You stay calm when things get tense; worry doesn't stick.
anxiety.high: Stress gets to you, and your mind is quick to run through what could go wrong.

hostility.low: Irritation passes quickly, and you let things go.
hostility.high: Annoyance comes fast, and you're inclined to hit back.

discipline.low: You keep things loose and decide in the moment.
discipline.high: You like plans and order, and you finish what you start.

risk_taking.low: You'd rather play it safe and skip the danger.
risk_taking.high: Danger and risk draw you in rather than put you off.

openness.low: You prefer the concrete and familiar to abstract ideas.
openness.high: You're full of ideas and drawn to variety and the abstract.

trust.low: You expect people to look out for themselves, and you stay on guard.
trust.high: You assume the best about people until shown otherwise.

guarded_carer.text: Caring but guarded: you feel for people, but they have to earn your trust.

nervous_social.text: Social but tense: you seek people out even though it can make you nervous.

curious_finisher.text: Curious and methodical: you chase new ideas and actually follow through on them.

jump_in.text: Jump first: you'd rather leap in and work it out on the way down.

warm_lead.text: Warm lead: you take charge, but with people's feelings in mind.

results_first.text: Results first: you take charge and keep feelings out of the way.

want_to_be_seen.text: Wanting to be seen: you'd like recognition even while you doubt yourself.

cool_head.text: Cool head: risk excites you without rattling you.

inner_explorer.text: Inner explorer: a busy world of ideas, mostly enjoyed on your own.

on_guard.text: On guard: you expect the worst from people and push back first.

quiet_principle.text: Quietly principled: you play fair without needing to be in charge.

planned_worry.text: Prepared worrier: planning ahead is how you keep worry in check.

easy_trust.text: Easy to get along with: you give people the benefit of the doubt and let slights go.

humble_helper.text: Quiet helper: you care about others without needing credit for it.
